# Espresso machine broken- very frustrating [Espressione Combination Espresso and Drip Coffee]

media poster

Media error

Hi all, hoping some of you, with experience with this machine, might be able to help me. Last year I got this Espressione dual espresso/ coffee pot machine as a wedding gift. Since we’ve received it, it has only worked correctly once or twice and never again. The thing seems to turn on correctly, but when pressing the button to make espresso- regardless of single or double- it never finishes making the drink, instead “stopping” short. This causes us to either have to press it 10-20 times to get a shot (sometimes this doesn’t even work) or give up entirely.

To make matters worse, the longer purple USB-C cable I ordered was supplied in white, I incurred additional redirection charges, and a goodwill gesture that customer support promised to escalate has never been followed up.  
  
Espresso’s final email simply confirmed that the monitor had been delivered, without addressing any of these outstanding issues.  
  
The monitor itself may be a premium product, but the service certainly hasn’t matched its price or the company’s public assurances.  
  
I will update this review again if espresso provides a satisfactory resolution.   
  
Original Review  
I ordered an espresso portable monitor for my business. UPS collected it on 27 October, but as of 6 November I still have no screen and no confirmed delivery date. [...] After repeated failed deliveries to a UPS Access Point, the tracking now shows an investigation and repeated warehouse scans. I have asked espresso to arrange delivery directly to my address or send a replacement.  
  
Despite clearly explaining that I want the screen, their latest response asked me to refuse delivery if it arrives and wait for it to return to their warehouse for a refund. That does not address my request.  
  
The delay is frustrating, but the lack of a clear resolution and the time spent chasing have made it worse. I would like someone to take ownership and confirm when I will receive the product I paid for.
